name: current-default-short-competition-four-wanted-discriminator
purpose: Predeclared current-default comparison of the bounded short-competition candidate on four exact, previously measured wanted rows: EME30 disk, HF GUI bright40e, paired weaker20e, and fresh-A40. No hf_compare_admitted_models or other experimental mode is enabled. Preserve source episode fields, seeds, physical profiles, SNRs, message, and sample caps; only episode IDs are normalized. Before outcomes, define a correct delivery as raw `correct_complete`: exact expected payload, zero wrong DATA bits/active erasures/false DATA, and scored physical quiet-slot completion. Report which strata improve or regress, exact per-slot decision changes, full-IQ input digests, native work/status, total wall, per-slot workspace, aggregate memory/owner count, and W=2*H source context. Treat outcomes as a bounded resilience and computation assessment across these frozen rows: do not promote based on a single row, and do not automatically veto the candidate from one newly wrong slot; quantify both gains and trade-offs. No outcome-dependent follow-up in this campaign, and no population/reliability or capacity claim.
